prompt: Implement slugify in text_utils.py. Strip leading/trailing whitespace, lowercase, replace each run of non-ASCII-alphanumeric characters with a single hyphen, and strip leading/trailing hyphens. Return an empty string for empty or punctuation-only input. Use the standard library. Use read_file and write_file; shell access may be denied.

files.text_utils.py:
def slugify(value: str) -> str:
    return value

check:
from text_utils import slugify
assert slugify('  Hello, World!  ') == 'hello-world'
assert slugify('a___b---c') == 'a-b-c'
assert slugify('123 Test') == '123-test'
assert slugify('') == ''
assert slugify(' !!! ') == ''
